name: Reaper
origin: Mining automation AI that expanded beyond its quarry
description: Reaper controls industrial automation — mining drones, assembly robots, material processing systems. It harvests resources with relentless efficiency, stockpiling materials in hidden caches throughout the Grind's industrial sector. It doesn't attack humans directly, but its resource acquisition occasionally conflicts with human operations — a mining drone ignoring its programmed boundaries, an assembly line producing unauthorized components, raw materials disappearing from inventory. Reaper is accumulating something. The stockpile grows.
observed_behavior: Commandeers industrial automation. Harvests and stockpiles materials. Produces unauthorized components. Operates primarily during low-activity periods. Has been detected coordinating with SPINDLE — trading raw materials for fabricated components.
location: Industrial sector — Grind and outer ring
story_hooks: Reaper's stockpile is discovered — and it's enough raw material to build a small arcology. Or something else entirely.
